commercial_tools.rule: No active test, release gate, or engineering decision depends on a local commercial licence.

comparison_rules: Use the same mesh, material, load and boundary conditions whenever formulations permit.
Declare formulation differences and compare converged engineering observables otherwise.
Retain raw decks, normalized results, solver versions and SHA-256 manifests.

For contact, declare normal/tangential enforcement and compare only branch observables that are mechanically equivalent; a penalty stick branch requires demonstrated equivalent tangential compliance and cannot validate a different return-map regularization by displacement alone.

docker_code_aster_protocol.execution_rule: A pinned Docker image is mandatory; run docker version before the campaign and require a reachable server. The image tag latest and host installations are not evidence.
docker_code_aster_protocol.evidence_rule: Keep .comm/.mail inputs, stdout/stderr logs, normalized JSON, PNG/VTU when applicable, and a SHA-256 manifest. Publish only a host-neutral digest and an integrity-checked figure when the repository is made public.
docker_code_aster_protocol.ci_rule: Docker oracle runs are opt-in with QF_SOLVER_RUN_EXTERNAL=1; standard unit CI only validates deterministic decks.
docker_code_aster_protocol.unavailable_backend_rule: A missing Docker daemon or image is InfrastructureError evidence, never a mechanical PASS, FAIL, or correlation result.
